input.quote: (a) Ono shall, and shall require its Affiliates to, permit Array, and/or an authorized representative reasonably acceptable to Ono, to enter the relevant facilities of Ono and its Affiliates during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice to inspect and verify compliance with applicable regulatory and other requirements, as well as with this Agreement, with respect to all matters relating to the Product
input.rationale: Two audit regimes bind us. Section 7.4 (p0481-p0482) is acceptable: inspections no more than once each Calendar Year, one inspection per quarter's records, by an independent accounting firm reasonably acceptable to Ono under a confidentiality agreement, at Array's expense unless underpayment exceeds a stated (redacted) threshold, with no system access — that sits at or near the preferred position (only the notice period is left as "reasonable" rather than a fixed day count, a minor sub-element). Section 4.9(a) (p0359), however, grants Array an unlimited-frequency right to enter Ono's and its Affiliates' facilities on merely "reasonable advance notice", to examine internal procedures and records, with no cost allocation and mandatory Ono assistance. Unlimited/unannounced-in-practice on-site inspections fall below the fallback (once per year on 15 days' notice, vendor bearing cost) and into walk-away territory, so we have made the minimal edit adding a once-per-Calendar-Year cap, 30 days' prior written notice and Array's cost, preserving a for-cause follow-up inspection right; on-site access is retained given the GxP context.

proposal.summary: Limit Section 4.9(a) inspections to once per Calendar Year on 30 days' written notice, at Array's expense.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.9(a) currently allows unlimited inspections of our facilities on merely "reasonable" notice and at our cost, so we have added our standard limits of one inspection per Calendar Year, thirty days' prior written notice and Array bearing its own inspection costs (with a carve-out for for-cause follow-up inspections). We can accept fifteen days' notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice to inspect
ops.newText: during normal business hours, no more than once per Calendar Year (other than a follow-up inspection reasonably required to verify remediation of a non-compliance previously identified), upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice and at Array's expense, to inspect
